lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Space is huge. Aliens must be everywhere.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Maybe. But then, where is everybody?

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: If they're out there, we'd hear them easily.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: We've listened since 1960. Not one clear signal.
lines.spoken: We've listened since nineteen sixty. Not one clear signal.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Our galaxy has billions of stars, and most have planets.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: And it's billions of years older than Earth.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Big numbers feel like proof. Without evidence, they're just a guess.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: So many stars, and total silence. That's the Fermi paradox.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Unless they heard us. And they're hiding.
